HOW TO PLAY KAPPO CRUNCH

STEP 1 OF 3

👈 Touch & Drag Movement Zones 👉

👈 TAP / DRAG LEFT
↻ TAP TOP TO ROTATE
👉 TAP / DRAG RIGHT

Tap or drag on the Left Half or Right Half of the board to position falling chip packets seamlessly!

STEP 2 OF 3

⚡ Speed Boost Control

⚡ SPEED BOOST

Hold the ⚡ Speed Boost button to temporarily accelerate gravity and drop packets faster!

STEP 3 OF 3

📦 Row Crunch & Mono-Flavor Multiplier

🔥 🔥 🔥 🔥 3X MULTIPLIER!

Fill complete horizontal rows to trigger a sequential packet crunch burst! Fill rows of the same flavor for massive 3x score multipliers!
